hook.name: ViperHook
hook.description: A VIPER/ETH pool hook that harvests fees on every swap and routes most to a fee splitter while burning a configurable portion, gates additional liquidity behind NFT burns (granting permanent reward shares to burners), tracks price milestone persistence to unlock NFT reveal batches, and executes automatic buyback-and-burn swaps from accumulated ETH fees when a threshold or interval is met.
